name: Nishi-Nippon Railroad Co., Ltd.
summary: Nishi-Nippon Railroad Co., Ltd. engages in the transportation business in Japan and internationally. It operates through five segments: Transportation; Real Estate; Distribution; Logistics; and Leisure and Services.
